name: Web-in-Air: Shop Connect for Telegram
author: Web-in-air

sections.description:
web-in-air-shop-connect-for-telegram connects your WooCommerce store to a Telegram bot, allowing your customers to browse products, view details, select variations, and much more, all without leaving their favorite messaging app.

This plugin offers a new, fast, and native shopping experience for millions of Telegram users.

Key Features:
* Browse products, categories, tags, and brands.
* Integrated product search.
* Display product details, price, descriptions, and photo gallery.
* Full support for variable products.
* Simple admin panel to configure your bot.

External Services

This plugin connects to the official Telegram Bot API (api.telegram.org) to send and receive messages. This connection is essential for the bot to function.

  • Service: Telegram Bot API
  • Purpose: Allows the WordPress site to interact with the Telegram bot (sending product info, menus, receiving user commands).
  • Data Sent: Bot token (for authentication), chat ID, message content (text, button data), product information requested by the user. No personal user data beyond the Telegram chat context is sent. Data is sent whenever a user interacts with the bot or when the plugin registers/deletes the webhook.
  • Links: Telegram Privacy Policy, Telegram Bot API Terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the web-in-air-shop-connect-for-telegram folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Woo Telegram” > “General” menu.
  4. Enter your Telegram bot token and your WooCommerce API keys.
  5. Enable the bot and start chatting with it on Telegram!
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce API keys?

Yes, API keys with Read/Write permissions are required for the bot to read your products and create carts.

Is the plugin compatible with variable products?

Absolutely! The bot interactively handles the selection of variations (e.g., size, color).
